name: BOM Weather
author: Daniel Zuccon
description: Australian Bureau of Meteorology weather in the Omarchy bar: real station observations, the 7-day forecast, hourly rain chances, and desktop notifications for BOM warnings.

barWidget.description: Weather for Australia from the Bureau of Meteorology — the data behind the BOM app. Badge shows the current conditions; the panel has observations, today's detail, hourly rain chances, the week ahead, and any active BOM warnings.

schema.label: Location
schema.description: Suburb, town or postcode, e.g. "Brighton VIC" or "3186". BOM covers Australia only; add the state or postcode when the name is ambiguous — the first match wins.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll the BOM API. Observations update roughly every 10 minutes; 300 s is the floor.

schema.label: Temperature on the badge
schema.description: temp = air temperature at the nearest BOM station. feels-like = BOM's apparent temperature.

schema.label: Notify on BOM warnings
schema.description: Desktop notification when the Bureau issues a new warning for your location (severe weather, storms, fire weather, floods…).
